title: Regional chlorophyll seasonality
query:
Characterize the seasonal cycle of surface chlorophyll across the South China Sea using MODIS-Aqua observations from 2003 to 2022. Determine how seasonal timing and amplitude differ between shelf and deep-basin waters.

Independently identify relevant literature and appropriate methods. Deliver an evidence-based report, supporting figures, and one executable analysis notebook. Distinguish demonstrated results from mechanisms that the supplied data cannot establish.
